content: {"praised":["Epic, 15 hour-long vignettes capturing Shakespeare’s history plays","Impressive supporting cast and strong performances","Great acting, especially Baddeley, Hermione, Angela","Timeless quality, still impressive after 50 years","Cohesive, well-paced storytelling across eight plays"],"criticized":["Poor sound quality, like old video recordings","Not filmed, low production quality","Some acting was bad, Falstaff not funny","Play cuts too short, losing depth","Not a complete theatrical experience"]}
